controls.label: Shape
controls.qualification: A sphere of the published radius, lit by K2-232; the neutral gray is a display convention, not a measured colour.
controls.notes: No image or colour of K2-232 c is published: the sphere has its measured size, and the gray marks an unresolved surface. The lighting is its own star's, at the measured orbit. The gray takes the colour of k2-232's light, as its colour lens measures it.

charts.alt: The orbits of K2-232's planets in this map from above, to scale, with K2-232 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

physical.credit: Radius from the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated radius (its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, since K2-232 c does not transit, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; mass from Ranshaw et al. 2026, the minimum mass (M sin i) the NASA Exoplanet Archive's composite table adopts (2026arXiv260909077R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive; orbit from Ranshaw et al. 2026 (2026arXiv260909077R), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive
